scope_statement: Strengthen traceability matrix validation: cross-artifact link checking against evidence card IDs, PRD requirement IDs, ADR IDs, TDD obligation IDs (current tdd.json plus historical satisfied IDs from implementation_ledger.jsonl), and existing brief/report file paths. Add TraceabilityLinkError type and ValidateTraceabilityCrossLinks function. Product lint uses broken_link finding code for cross-artifact failures distinct from parse_error. Preserve existing durable traceability_matrix.json fixture.

fallback_after_timeout.allowed_scope: C1 traceability matrix schema/link validation, product lint integration, focused tests, and durable Atom 7 workflow bookkeeping only

commands: JSON/JSONL validation for durable workflow artifacts
privacy secret-pattern scan over durable effort artifacts

privacy_note: Report contains validation error messages, path strings, and typed counters only; no raw prompt, transcript, file body, secret, or customer-identifying data is persisted.
